highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback on Skia m152.
highlights_body: The release also strengthens pixel and native-object lifetime safety, adds a Vulkan Silk.NET package, and improves HarfBuzz shaping performance.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent upstream stability and servicing fixes.
Exposes Graphite support for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so applications can adopt Skia's modern GPU backend.
SKImage and SKSurface now provide backend-neutral RequestReadPixels APIs for asynchronous readback.
Fixes use-after-free risks in SKRegion iteration and SKPixmap subsets, and releases raster pixel memory when SKImage creation fails.

bullets.lead: Data and text helpers avoid unnecessary allocations
bullets.detail: Improves SKData.SaveTo and encoded-text retrieval efficiency while preserving their existing behavior.
Reset disposes the previous uniform buffer, and uniform lookup initialization is sized for the known uniform count.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz stream conversion releases native resources
bullets.detail: Converting a non-memory-backed stream to a HarfBuzz blob no longer leaves its SKStreamAsset undisposed.
Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and validates Vulkan support on Android and Linux.

bullets.lead: Nano Server font support uses FreeType
bullets.detail: Provides reliable font support for Nano Server through the FreeType backend.
Produces symbol packages for Apple native assets to aid diagnostics.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Enabled FreeType font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved native Windows builds by initializing the MSVC environment once
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced Skia m152, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and the Vulkan Silk.NET package.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added m152 servicing fixes, Apple native symbols, and lifecycle and performance improvements.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzz shaping by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy and fixes native stream cleanup when creating blobs.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Skia m152, Graphite GPU bindings, and asynchronous pixel readback.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: The preview also adds a Vulkan Silk.NET package and improves native-object lifetime handling.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 adds m152 servicing updates and release-quality improvements.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It includes Apple native symbol packages alongside HarfBuzz and runtime lifecycle refinements.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 delivers the Skia m152 release with Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel readback.
v4.152.0.body: It also includes improved platform packages, safer native-object lifetimes, and HarfBuzz shaping refinements.
